quote: When overtaking or passing a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter proceeding in the same direction, the driver of a motor vehicle shall exercise due care and: If there is more than one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction, move the vehicle to the lane to the immediate left, if the lane is available and moving into the lane is reasonably safe.

activation.condition: Motor-vehicle driver overtakes or passes a qualifying bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter proceeding in the same direction.

obligation.description: Exercise due care and, when more than one same-direction lane exists, move to the immediate-left lane if available and reasonably safe.

exceptions.source_clause: if the lane is available and moving into the lane is reasonably safe
exceptions.disposition: original source review required; no invented threshold

timing.description: At original overtaking or passing interval and lane movement.

parameter_refs.name: control_kind
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter

parameter_refs.name: same_direction_lane_count_requested
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: one or two surveyed same-direction lanes

parameter_refs.name: ego_maneuver_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: move left, stay, pass or follow
